caption: The video captures a close view of a blue-felt pool table where a player in a red shirt holds a wooden cue at the far rail. The cue tip contacts the red-dotted white cue ball, then draws back while the ball rolls forward. The white ball closes on the red-and-white striped 15-ball and strikes it, after which the striped ball stays near the left while the cue ball continues to its right. The balls appear larger in frame as their surfaces rotate and the motion eases. The cue moves out of view, and the blurred orange ball at the lower foreground leaves the edge. The 15-ball remains at rest on the left, while the cue ball still rolls slowly to the right.
